content:
Let the divisor be \(d\). Since the least number added is \(5\),

\[
228712 + 5 = 228717
\]

must be divisible by \(d\). Also, \(d>5\); for example, \(d=3\) divides \(228717\), but \(228712 \bmod 3=1\), so the least addition would be \(2\), not \(5\).

Factor:

\[
228717 = 3^3 \cdot 43 \cdot 197
\]

Thus every divisor of \(228717\) greater than \(5\) works, e.g. \(9,27,43,197,\dots\). So the divisor is not uniquely determined.

\[
\boxed{\text{Not uniquely determined; if the smallest such divisor is intended, it is }9.}
\]
